Insights Talk to Sthitha

Connecting People Through Quantum Technology

Quantum technology is developing through research, education and collaboration across disciplines. Events create opportunities to exchange ideas, explore emerging technologies and connect with people interested in what comes next.

Sthitha Quantum Innovations engages with the wider technology and academic community through events, educational initiatives and opportunities for collaboration.

Explore Our Activities Contact Sthitha
About Our Community

Building Connections Around Emerging Technology

Our community

Understanding quantum computing and other emerging technologies takes more than individual study. Discussions, events and shared learning can help people discover new perspectives and understand how different fields connect.

Sthitha aims to engage with students, educators, researchers and technology professionals who are interested in quantum computing, post-quantum security and related fields, and to encourage awareness, learning and meaningful conversations around emerging technology.

Events and participation

Technology events bring together people with different backgrounds and interests. They can provide opportunities to exchange knowledge, introduce new ideas and connect with others working across science, engineering and technology.

Sthitha supports engagement with the broader technology community and welcomes opportunities to take part in relevant educational and technical initiatives. Involvement may include event participation, sponsorship and conversations around technology education and collaboration, depending on the opportunity.

Sthitha Quantum Innovations sponsored AURORA '26, supporting an event focused on technology and innovation. Our involvement reflects our interest in engaging with the wider technology community and supporting opportunities that bring people together around emerging ideas.

Opportunities for Collaboration

Let's Build Meaningful Connections

Sthitha welcomes conversations with organisations, educational institutions, event organisers and individuals interested in quantum technology and emerging computing fields.

Each opportunity is considered according to its relevance and scope. Contact us to discuss a potential initiative.

About Sthitha Quantum Innovations

Sthitha is interested in technology, education and community initiatives related to quantum computing, emerging technologies and post-quantum security. Specific participation details should be confirmed through official announcements.

Sthitha Quantum Innovations sponsored AURORA '26, an IEEE technology event held on 2–3 October 2026.

Check Sthitha's official website and communication channels for confirmed announcements about events organised by the company. Sponsorship or participation does not mean an event was organised by Sthitha.

Organisations, educational institutions and event organisers can contact Sthitha to discuss relevant opportunities involving quantum education, technology and research interests.

Sthitha Academy offers introductory learning opportunities, including the Quantum Computing Crash Course and Quantum Computing in Malayalam for beginners.

Be Part of the Conversation

Whether you are exploring quantum computing, planning a technology event or interested in educational and technical collaboration, connect with Sthitha Quantum Innovations.
